system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s draft is **not acceptable as drafted**. The Disclosure Letter records several unresolved facts; it does not cure the corresponding SPA protections or establish that the matters are immaterial.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 — General liability cap** | 20% / AUD 4.8m. | 25% / AUD 6m starting cap. | **Reject 20%:** it is a fallback requiring Amelia Frost’s prior written authority identifying this draft; none has been given. |
| **SPA-N-002 — De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis; AUD 250,000 deductible basket. | AUD 5,000 de minimis; AUD 50,000 basket, recoverable from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Counter:** the proposed thresholds materially reduce recovery. |
| **SPA-N-003 — General claims time limit** | 18 months, with limits presumptively applying to all Claims. | 24 months for general Warranty Claims only. | **Reject:** 18 months needs Amelia Frost’s written approval, and general limits must not spread to other claim categories. |
| **SPA-N-004 — Fundamental/Title regime** | Same cap and time limit as general warranties. | Separate 100% cap, at least six years, outside general thresholds and knowledge bar. | **Reject:** title and capacity require independent, longer-lasting protection. |
| **SPA-N-005 — Fraud carve-out** | Limits, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims. | Express carve-out for fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct from all caps, thresholds, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insist:** this protection is non-waivable under the playbook. |
| **SPA-N-006 — Disclosure scope** | Whole data room, accounts, registers and public records deemed disclosed. | Specific, fair disclosure against identified warranties. | **Delete general deemed disclosure:** availability or searchability does not show the Buyer was fairly informed of a particular exception. |
| **SPA-N-007 — Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Blanket bar for Buyer/adviser knowledge, including discoverable matters. | Delete; any seller-knowledge qualifier must name persons and require reasonable enquiry, and must not excuse title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Reject:** deemed Buyer knowledge would undermine the warranties and disclosure standard. |
| **SPA-N-008 — Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied on delivery of written consent, without evidence of conditions being met. | Effective consent **and evidence that its conditions are satisfied before Completion**. | **Keep as a hard condition:** Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue and the disclosed consent package is incomplete. |
| **SPA-N-009 — Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; security release after Completion. | Current payout figure, direct repayment from Completion funds and effective releases at Completion. | **Reject deferred release:** any post-Completion release needs an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost’s approval. |
| **SPA-N-010 — Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional bonuses omitted from funds flow; on-costs unstated. | Specific funds-flow line item, including triggered on-costs, or seller funding. | **Revise funds flow:** the Completion-triggered exposure must not be silently excluded. |
| **SPA-N-011 — Ironquay IP indemnity** | Narrow indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment. | Broader indemnity for the IP ownership/transfer risk while preserving the SOW3 payment cure. | **Expand and verify:** AUD 180,000 is an open record, not independent proof of payment or non-payment; no receipt or confirmatory assignment is supplied. |
| **SPA-N-012 — Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary and not expected to be material. | Preserve logs, investigate scope/access and notification duties, and provide updates. | **Add investigation covenants:** the record establishes neither a confirmed breach nor no breach, harm, notification duty or loss figure. |
| **SPA-N-013 — Sandbar renewals** | AUD 330,000 aggregate ordinary-course operating costs. | Assess timing, scope, avoidability, termination and accrual. | **Investigate, not automatically deduct:** the disclosure does not establish ordinary-course treatment or Debt classification. |
| **SPA-N-014 — Category separation** | General-regime limits and reliance provisions extend to all Claims; tax/IP treated as settled. | Distinct Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant regimes, without a hidden general-regime override. | **Redraft cross-references:** a broad “all Claims” formulation would erase category-specific protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 — Title verification** | DD-012 internal share register is treated as title evidence. | Independent evidence of ownership, encumbrances and authority. | **Require verification:** a supplied register alone is not independent proof of clean title or capacity. |
| **SPA-N-016 — Tax/IP open terms** | Tax and IP positions said to be settled under the general regime. | Keep both expressly open for separate negotiation; do not assume unlimited liability. | **Reserve position:** neither category has been resolved by the stated Seller position. |
=== END ADVICE ===
